summary: Frontend-only verification of the v2 visual redesign (Chats · AI · Tasks · Calls · You). All 14 review items were exercised on mobile 430x932 via Playwright (https://nest-app-prep.preview.emergentagent.com). Welcome screen, demo login, 5-tab bottom bar, hiding of the bar on chat-detail/call routes, filter chips, chat-detail header w/ audio+video call buttons, grouped composer, Tasks page with scope tabs / collapsible sections / tap-to-cycle status pill / FAB → NewTaskDialog, Calls page with people picker + Audio/Video CTAs + filter + empty state, You hub with avatar / CreditRing / Free Plan / settings list / logout / version, Billing with 160px ring + monthly/annual segmented + plan cards, /me alias to /you, and 14 legacy route regression — ALL working. Backend NOT tested per request.

issues: VoiceRecorder buttons (the visible 'VOICE' chip, Stop/Save/Cancel/Replay/Discard) still use `font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[10px]` styling — visible 'VOICE' uppercase mono label in composer at /chats/:chatId. Spec §7: 'No more uppercase mono labels'. File: /app/frontend/src/components/VoiceRecorder.jsx lines 112, 131, 150, 159, 207 (label-mono 'VOICE NOTE'), 224, 232, 240.

All field labels (TITLE / DESCRIPTION / ASSIGN TO / DUE DATE / PRIORITY / STATUS / PROJECT FOLDER) use the legacy `label-mono` class (font-mono uppercase tracking-widest). The 'CREATE TASK & NOTIFY ASSIGNEE' confirm button also uses `font-mono uppercase tracking-widest`. Spec §13 says no MONO-UPPERCASE labels remain anywhere except code-style model badges. File: /app/frontend/src/components/NewTaskDialog.jsx lines 121, 148, 157, 161, 166, 182, 186, 200, 210, 218.

action_items: Polish: migrate VoiceRecorder.jsx button + 'VOICE NOTE' chip styling away from font-mono/uppercase/tracking-widest — match the rest of the chat composer (Attach / Improve / Ask AI use sentence-case Inter).

Polish: migrate NewTaskDialog.jsx field labels (TITLE/DESCRIPTION/ASSIGN TO/DUE DATE/PRIORITY/STATUS/PROJECT FOLDER) + confirm CTA away from `label-mono` to Inter sentence-case to fully satisfy §13 typography rule.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileTabBar.jsx correctly hides on /chats/:chatId and /call/:callId via regex check, and renders the 5 spec'd tabs in the correct order with correct accent colors (AI=#B794F4, others=#FFD23F).

App.js wires /you and /me to the same Me page, /calls to Calls, /chats and /chats/:chatId to Chats — exactly per spec §12. All 14 regression routes return 200; /my-ai correctly redirects to a personal AI chat URL as before.

Chats.jsx filter values are: all/direct/group/ai/unread → testids chat-filter-{value}. Spec mentions 'Groups' label which maps to testid `chat-filter-group` (singular). If E1 wants strict literal-label testid suffix (`chat-filter-groups`), this needs a one-line change at /app/frontend/src/pages/Chats.jsx:66 — otherwise leave as-is since the visible label IS 'Groups' and the prefix matches spec.

Chats.jsx chat row testid prefix is `chat-item-` (carry-over). Spec §4 doesn't mandate a testid name for rows, but the review notes 'data-testid prefix chat-filter-' for chips and `chat-row-` is never explicitly required. Backward-compat preserved — fine.

Tasks.jsx: `section-needs_review` and `section-done` only render when their respective list has ≥1 task (collapsible sections hidden when empty). Demo seed currently has 0 in each, so those testids were absent — by design, not a bug. The status pill tap-to-cycle does work: after one click, count summary went from '2 to do · 3 in progress' to '1 to do · 4 in progress'.
Calls.jsx renders empty state ('No calls yet') correctly when zero calls exist. 12 call-pick-{user_id} buttons rendered for the 12 demo members/invitees including Audio/Video CTAs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of v2 review items pass; 2 minor mono-uppercase residues remain in VoiceRecorder + NewTaskDialog (out of the rewritten primitives but inside reused dialog/voice modules)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 26 fully verifies the v2 visual redesign. The only remaining typography deltas are inside two non-primitive modules: VoiceRecorder.jsx and NewTaskDialog.jsx. All 5 mobile-tab routes, push-detail hide pattern, /you hub, billing ring, Calls inbox, and Tasks collapsible+tap-pill flow are wired correctly. Backend was untouched.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. Two design polish gaps remain: (1) the VoiceRecorder embedded into the composer still uses pre-v2 mono-uppercase chrome — the chat composer rewrite did not migrate this sub-component. (2) NewTaskDialog likewise still has `label-mono` field captions — only the Tasks page itself was rewritten, not its dialog. Both are one-pass styling edits, no logic changes required.
